name: News-event positive-shock drift — enter at the moment good news breaks
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from llm-narrative-pressure-long, which enters when news_event_score is ABOVE a level — a sustained-state read; this enters on the CROSS UP through a magnitude floor — the discrete MOMENT a bullish catalyst breaks, capturing the post-announcement drift): markets under-react to genuine catalysts because attention diffuses gradually; a typed positive news shock (approval, listing, adoption, partnership — sign + magnitude in [-1,+1]) is incrementally priced over several days (post-event drift / under-reaction, documented in equities and crypto event studies). Entering at the cross harvests the drift between the headline and full diffusion. Entry: news_event_score crosses UP through a fitted positive-magnitude floor (a fresh bullish catalyst) AND price not in a downtrend (the catalyst confirms, the tape doesn't fight it). Exit: news_event_score crosses DOWN back toward neutral (the catalyst is fully priced / narrative fading) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if entering on the news_event_score LEVEL (gt) does as well, the cross adds no timing edge and this is llm-narrative-pressure-long re-skinned. Disconfirmer 2: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the news shock adds nothing — the edge must be the catalyst, not generic trend. Disconfirmer 3 (LLM-on-path guard): the LLM only standardizes headline text at ingest, NEVER on the gate/money path — the score is a frozen PIT feature. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the drift must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier1 news feature, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: the moment a typed positive news catalyst breaks — captured at the cross, ridden through its drift
